name: Queen Naeja's Desires
source:
Players take on the role of Feng Yufei, a modern-day agent reincarnated as the Sixth Princess Consort of the Lingxiong Empire. Trapped in a treacherous royal court, you must wield wisdom and supernatural abilities granted by a mysterious system to unravel conspiracies, rewrite fate, and carve your legend amidst the whirlwind of power and passion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演现代特工凤羽飞，转世为凌雄帝国六王妃。身陷险恶的宫廷，你必须运用神秘系统赋予的智慧和超能力，解开阴谋，改写命运，在权力与激情的旋风中谱写属于你的传奇。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3434050/]Steam[/url]]
